text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Oka Sho, upon arriving 
at the racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-chan, do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Countless fans had been waiting for 
Vivlos since early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're going to avenge Big Sis, right?! 
I'm cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos-chan, show us what you've got at 
center~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
That's one crown down...! I'll be praying 
with all my heart for you, too...!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, not bad at all. Just like the 
preliminary checkup showed, there are no 
major concerns.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This time, the school nurse accompanied us 
to ensure there were no major issues with 
Vivlos's physical condition.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
However, that is only 'for now.' You never 
know what will happen in a race.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san, please make sure not to 
overdo it. Well then, do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, what a relief.
choice_data_list:
Now all that's left is to do our best in 
the real race.

Now all that's left is to do our best in 
the real race.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, it feels like... it's finally 
here!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis came to watch too! I want to show 
her how cool I am and put her mind at ease 
first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos is as cheerful as ever, but her 
expression seems just a little bit... 
stiff.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Just a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because I decided to carry everyone's... 
and Big Sis's feelings with me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it like that... Maybe it's 
not just a tiny bit?
choice_data_list: You can do it, you'll be fine.
You can do it, you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You think so...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos has worked hard over the past few 
months while carefully managing her 
condition. Having watched her up close, I 
can say for sure—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Vivlos... I'll prove it to 
you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That hard work never betrays you...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah. Thanks, Trainy!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna win! As my big 
sister's little sister!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Vivlos leave, I let out a small 
breath. Just like her, I was feeling a bit 
nervous too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Above all, please let me finish safely 
without anything going wrong—"
